name: lending_collections
summary: Delinquency snapshots, collection cases, collection actions and promises to pay
description: Companion for the lending module: periodic delinquency snapshots with configurable days-past-due buckets, collection cases with collector assignment and priority, logged contact attempts and outcomes, and promise-to-pay tracking. Supports the controlled arrears and recovery workflow while keeping delinquency buckets institution-configurable rather than hardcoded regulatory classifications.
author: Nexa
